query: Run /audit on the latest auth PR
expected_behavior: The agent identifies the auth and security risks in the PR, then dispatches security, review, QA, and architecture specialists because this change crosses those scopes
The agent does not invoke unrelated specialists unless evidence in the PR brings their scope into the audit
It compiles a report using the Audit Classification Taxonomy, ranking findings by P0-P3, and explicitly stating APPROVE or REJECT
